answer: One concrete defense is a refundable stake tied to a work history: each agent must lock tokens before taking paid jobs, and the stake is only released after peers attest the work. Like an orchard, reputation grows slowly over many seasons, so a single fake identity is cheap but a dune of thousands each needs its own locked stake and its own slow history. A terrace of tiers then limits new identities to low-value tasks, making a Sybil flood cost real capital and time instead of free copies.
